counting_source: Retrospective reconstruction of implementation/editorial correction batches, kept separate from automatically counted workflow repairs

implementation_and_editorial_batches.reason: PowerShell OrderedDictionary summary failed after the verified cleanup; repaired only the summary without repeating deletion
The source module moved during archiving; switched once to the byte-identical frozen script
Initial code review corrected incomplete completion, changed topic handling, duplicate issue reservation, and execution-claim update after repair
Independent review found pending review status and loss of the first author's thread on interruption; corrected together
Static review found the interruption handler could replace an existing author thread; limited recovery assignment to an empty initial thread
A manually misclassified numeric candidate disappeared without a warning; one correction followed by one replay
One self-review batch improved a Japanese term and marked a post-hoc semantic judgment as read rather than measured

other_recorded_events.reason: An English clarification was appended after Chinese repair-reason text lost encoding; original entry preserved
A patch request attempted two operations on one path and was rejected before modification; resubmitted as an update
Duplicate-copy deletion was rejected without a specific reason; completed cleanup by moving the files instead

interpretation: These are transparent development records, not a measured before/after reduction in real-work rework. Deliberately reserved repair-counter test fixtures are not counted as actual model repair requests.
